channel.title: The Local France - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Local France (thelocal.fr)

item.title: 36 days and counting: When will it stop raining in France?
item.description: With France having already broken a record for 36 consecutive days of rain, the question being asked, in increasingly shrill tones, is when will the wet weather end?

item.title: La Belle Vie: Rainy Paris, being bilingual and the return of a movie classic
item.description: From the never-ending rain in Paris to a movie throwback, via the complexities of speaking two languages, this week’s La Belle Vie newsletter offers an essential starting point for eating, talking, drinking, and living like a local.

item.title: Suspects charged over killing of French far-right activist
item.description: A French court brought homicide charges on Thursday against two suspects in the fatal beating of a far-right activist that has fuelled political anger in France and beyond.

item.title: French minister pledges tight security at rally for killed activist
item.description: French police will be out in force at a weekend rally for a slain far-right activist, the interior minister said on Friday as the country seeks to contain anger over the fatal beating blamed on the hard left.

item.title: French expression of the day: Ne pas être né de la dernière pluie
item.description: This French expression seems quite fitting with France undergoing endless days of rain.

item.title: TELL US: Are you affected by tighter French citizenship rules for under 30s?
item.description: Recent changes to the rules on applying for French citizenship have made the process especially difficult for young people - even if they arrived in France as young children and spent their whole life here. We want to hear from young people (or their parents) affected by this.

item.title: Can dual national Brits travel to UK without valid British passport after all?
item.description: Upcoming rule changes to the UK's new ETA border system have angered dual national Brits, but updated travel guidance from the government and a major airline suggests those without valid British passports may be allowed entry - as long as they have an expired UK passport.

item.title: Everything that changes in France in March 2026
item.description: From municipal elections to a new parcel tax and an increase in vehicle registration, here is what is on the agenda for March 2026 in France.

item.title: Your views: ‘We must be willing to participate the same way French locals do’
item.description: Comments by readers of The Local France—whether opinions, advice, or tales of life in the country—offer vital insights to others. We've picked out some recent contributions on topics spanning the hurdles foreigners face as they try to integrate into French life, the administrative reality of "fairness" in the 2026 budget, and the hidden identity crisis that comes with being bilingual.

item.title: 'It must be humane and individual' - Meet the Senator challenging France's strict new citizenship rules
item.description: French senator Nicole Bonnefoy - who has recently raised a series of question in the Senate on this issue - told The Local that new guidance on income requirements for French citizenship must not unfairly penalise retirees or children who grew up here, and says decisions should be based on "the whole life story".
